name: Clock Out
summary: A retirement card where a walnut wall clock spins through the years, stops at five and stamps the last card
about: A full retirement page on a sunlit office wall: a walnut regulator clock drops onto its nail and spins through every year of service while little year tags fly off, then slows, stops dead at five o'clock and chimes five times. The time recorder beside it punches the last card OUT with the date, and the sign below flips from At my desk to Off for good. Type the name, start year, workplace and a message, then copy a link that opens the card made for them.
how: Open the page: the clock drops in, spins from the start year to today, stops at five and chimes; the card gets stamped OUT.
Drag the minute hand backwards to rewind the years (or focus the dial and use the arrow keys); let go and it springs back.
Push the pendulum: the clock ticks for a moment, then stops again, because it knows you are retired.
Tap the time card to punch it again, or press Clock out again to replay the whole thing.
In Make yours, type the name, the year they started, the workplace, an optional last day and a message, or pick a ready one.
Copy the link (or Share on a phone) and send it; it opens this card with your words.
